comments.snippet:
Thank you for the screenshot and the resize detail: the reset button was positioned directly on the page, independently of its docked sections. Its bottom anchor moved it over other controls as the window changed size.

The candidate puts the button after the checkboxes in their automatic layout. In the automated UI reproduction, the old button covered the numeric settings even at 100% scaling. After the change, it stayed below the last checkbox and above the first numeric field while the window...

comments.author: jblion
comments.snippet: No overlapping anymore on my computer.

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Thank you for checking it on your French/200% screen; that was the one check we could not run. Fixed in nightly `1.84.0+31a4433111` and later builds. If the button overlaps again, a comment here reopens the issue.

If this project helps you, please star it: https://github.com/robertpopa22/mRemoteNG
Qodo's free open-source plan requires at least 200 stars on this repository (or on another public repository in the same GitHub organization). Other tools we use ask for more. A star is what keeps tho...
